subject: Mental Models
title: Biological Mimicry
description: A short lesson to help you apply Biological Mimicry.

hook.text: Velcro was invented after a Swiss engineer studied burrs stuck to his dog's fur.

buildup.text: Biomimicry borrows solutions from nature. Shark skin inspired low-drag swimsuits.

discovery.text: Evolution is the longest-running R&D lab in history.

twist.text: Not all biological solutions transfer. Wings work for birds but not for planes at scale. Know when the analogy breaks.

climax.text: When stuck on a design problem, ask: has nature solved something similar? The answer is usually yes.

punchline.text: Nature already solved it. Look there first.

quiz.question: Why is biomimicry a valuable problem-solving approach?
options: All biological solutions transfer perfectly to engineering
Evolution has tested solutions over billions of years of trial and error
Nature is always simpler than engineering
